result: I’d make empathy a prerequisite for power. Politicians, executives, and public figures should have to demonstrate genuine care for people whose lives differ from their own before they’re allowed to lead. Most cruelty doesn’t begin with hatred; it begins with the belief that other people’s suffering is distant and unimportant.
